text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=runtime-hotpath in us-west — p99 latency > 1200ms (4 hits). Auto-escalation enabled. graph: https://grafana/redwood/d/abcd

alex: acked. I'm oncall, jumping in. starting triage. tagging @jamie for kv-cache / sidecar checks.

jamie: ack. looking now — seeing tail latency and elevated queue depth on hotpath sidecars, qps spike to kv-host-3. possible backpressure. grabbing logs.

maria: noticed a small deploy ~10m ago to eu-west, shouldn't touch us-west but validating routing rules.

alex: quick query: long-context requests spiked from select clients, avg batch size up ~3x. could be bursty tenant.

jamie: applying temporary mitigation: lowering max-batch-ms on hotpath pool to 10ms to reduce queueing. rolling config now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty auto-escalation will fire in 2m if unacked. Current status: acknowledged by alex.

leo: joining from level2. acking. scaling dedicated hotpath pool +2 GPUs, warming kv-host-4. ETA ~2m.

alex: deploying a fallback route to model-variant-quantized when latency > 800ms to shed load. starting canary.

maria: customer-impact check: only a small subset of us-west clients on long-context paths. no errors reported, just higher latencies.

jamie: KV miss rate spiked on kv-host-3 concurrently. initiating cache warmup and shifting ~30% traffic to kv-host-4 now.

alex: monitoring dashboard — p99 dropping from ~1.4s to ~0.85s after routing changes. continuing observation.

leo: keeping autoscaled capacity until stable. will suppress further auto-escalations to avoid PD churn. :thumbsup:

maria: collecting traces and request_ids for postmortem: saving to /incidents/1765554322/trace-samples. please add any suspect request ids.

alex: good catch. updating PD incident to "stabilized — monitoring". handoff planned in 30m if metrics stay steady. thanks team.

jamie: will follow up with root-cause notes once cache warmup completes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC1765554322 updated: status=acknowledged, priority=high, assignees=[alex, leo].
